official.deadline_note: Each Sending Partner may set its own, often earlier, national deadline; supervisor statements for doctoral applicants (where the Doctoral School requires one) and recommendation letters for self-financed applicants are due 15 March 2026; missing documents under a signed declaration may be uploaded until 1 August 2026.
official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 cycle - application period opened 14 November 2025 and closed 15 January 2026; the 2027/2028 call had not yet been published as of 10 October 2026
official.status_note: The homepage still displays the 2026/2027 call banner, but the programme runs a single annual round whose deadline was 15 January 2026, 2 p.m. CET; results were communicated by end of June/beginning of July 2026. No 2027/2028 deadline is published yet - historically the next round opens in November and closes mid-January.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Call for Applications section 1.3 states 'exemption from the payment of tuition fee' for scholarship holders.
benefits: Tuition-free education: exemption from the payment of tuition fee
Monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 for non-degree, bachelor, master and one-tier master levels - a contribution to living expenses in Hungary, for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Doctoral level: HUF 140,000 per month for the first phase (4 semesters) and HUF 180,000 per month for the second phase (4 semesters), for 12 months a year
Free dormitory place (depending on institutional capacity) or a contribution of HUF 40,000 per month to accommodation costs for the whole duration of the scholarship period
Medical insurance: health care services according to Hungarian legislation plus supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65,000 a year per person
Free compulsory Hungarian as a foreign language and culture course from the Host Institution for full-time bachelor, master and one-tier master students
eligibility: Only nominated applicants can proceed - nomination by the responsible Sending Partner in the applicant's country or region is mandatory
Applications are accepted only for study programmes supported by the cooperation agreement between Hungary and the sending country or region
Applications are accepted for bachelor, master, one-tier master, non-degree and postgraduate specialist training courses OR doctoral programmes, but not for both in the same application round

Self-financed students of Hungarian higher education institutions are eligible at their current study level only with a host-university recommendation and a cumulative, corrected sum average above the programme average
An entrance examination score of at least 56 out of 100 points is required to be considered for the final list of scholarship awardees
Applicants applying only to Hungarian-language full degree programmes who fail the language test cannot be admitted anywhere
Scholarship holders must habitually reside in Hungary during the study period and must not hold another scholarship that prevents use of the award
requirements: Fill out all requested information on the online application form in English and submit (not merely save) the application in the Tempus Public Foundation system by 15 January 2026, 2 p.m. CET
Submit the application also to the responsible authority of the Sending Partner, which may impose different deadlines and requirements
Contact the responsible Sending Partner as early as possible; sending partners nominate by end of February (28 February 2026 for this cycle)
Select at most two study programmes relevant to the field of studies; selected programmes and their order of preference cannot be changed after the deadline

Upload a scanned copy of the original proof of language proficiency with the minimum level determined by the Host Institution, together with its translation (previous studies completed in the language of the selected programme may be accepted instead)
Write a motivation letter of at least one page, in Times New Roman 12-point, in the language of the selected study programme or Hungarian
documents: Online application form completed in English with a recent photo (partial studies applicants must state the length in months and start date)
Proof of language proficiency and its translation
Secondary school graduation certificate or bachelor/master degree certificate for the level applied for (conditional acceptance until 1 August 2026)

Copy of a valid passport, or a national ID card plus a signed declaration that a valid passport will be obtained (medical certificate on the mandatory template is presented on arrival in Hungary, only by awardees)
selection_criteria: First selection point (28 February 2026): technical check and the Sending Partner's nomination process
Second selection point (mid-March to end of May 2026): institutional admission procedure at the host university
Minimum entrance examination score of 56 out of 100 points for the final list of awardees
Primary choices are considered first, giving stronger chances to programmes selected as primary choices
Official results are communicated by Tempus Public Foundation by the end of June or beginning of July
coverage: Tuition fees are covered in full (exemption from the payment of tuition fee)
A monthly stipend as a contribution to living expenses in Hungary, for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Accommodation contribution: free dormitory place subject to institutional capacity, or HUF 40,000 per month
Medical insurance: health care services under the relevant Hungarian legislation plus supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65,000 a year per person
The Call for Applications states these provisions are only a contribution to living expenses and do not fully cover living costs; students must add their own financial resources
application_method: Contact the responsible Sending Partner (Hungarian Embassy, ministry, council or equivalent) in your country and obtain nomination
Register at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu, select up to two eligible study programmes and upload all required documents
Submit the complete application online by the deadline and submit to the Sending Partner according to its procedure
Sit the institutional entrance examination when the host university contacts you between mid-March and end of May
Accept the scholarship offer within one week in the online system, then start the visa application as early as possible
official.application_route: Online application through Tempus Public Foundation's system (apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu) with mandatory Sending Partner nomination; no direct application to universities.
official.study_mode: Full-time and partial (exchange) study modes available; the Hungarian-language preparatory course is full-time only
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be nominated by the responsible Sending Partner in their country or region and may apply only where a valid education cooperation agreement with Hungary exists; scholarship holders must habitually reside in Hungary during the study period.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is open to international students from countries and regions with an active education cooperation agreement with Hungary.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only study programmes supported by the cooperation agreement between Hungary and the sending country or region may be applied for; a maximum of two programme choices relevant to the applicant's field of studies.
official.research_requirement: Doctoral applicants must submit a statement of supervisor by 15 March 2026 if required by the chosen Doctoral School; doctoral studies run 8 semesters in two 4-semester phases with a complex exam after the first phase.
official.duration: Bachelor 2-4 years; master 1-2 years; one-tier master 5-6 years; postgraduate specialist training courses 1-2 years; partial (exchange) studies 1-2 semesters; Hungarian-language preparatory course 1 year; doctoral programmes 8 semesters (4+4).
official.description: A Hungarian Government scholarship programme implemented by Tempus Public Foundation to promote the internationalisation of Hungarian higher education and attract top international students. As a scholarship holder, tuition fees are covered and accommodation and living costs are contributed to, allowing focus on academic advancement in the heart of Europe.

not_confirmed: english_requirement: no centrally published IELTS/TOEFL score; the minimum level of language proficiency is set by each Host Institution
2027/2028 cycle deadline: not yet published on the official site as of 2026-10-10
verification.notes: Stipend, accommodation, medical insurance and deadline figures read directly from section 1.3 and section 3 of the 2026/2027 Calls for Applications PDFs published on stipendiumhungaricum.hu; travel exclusion and 40,000 HUF housing allowance confirmed on the official 'Your stay in Hungary' page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is genuinely full tuition relief plus a fixed monthly stipend, not a living grant: HUF 43,700 per month at bachelor/master/one-tier master level (HUF 140,000 then HUF 180,000 for doctoral phases), about HUF 43,700/month spread across living costs against typical Hungarian rents, which is why the programme itself warns you must top it up from your own funds. Two gates can end your bid before any university even sees your file: securing Sending Partner nomination and the 15 January 14:00 CET cutoff in the Tempus system. Timing is brutal because it is a single annual round - miss 15 January and your next chance is a full year away.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong academic students from countries with a Hungary cooperation agreement who can win a nomination and can absorb travel and top-up living costs themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: In November-December, confirm your country has active SH cooperation and identify your exact Sending Partner office and its own (often earlier) deadline
Cross-check your two programme choices against the annex list of eligible programmes for your country - programmes outside the cooperation agreement cannot be applied for
Get proof of language proficiency translated and scanned at certificate level, since the host institution sets the minimum level
Draft the motivation letter to the exact spec: at least one page, Times New Roman 12-point, in the language of the programme or Hungarian
Register early in apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu and submit well before 14:00 CET on 15 January - the system, not the Partner, is the gate that closes
If you are a self-financed student in Hungary, line up the host-university recommendation letter before 15 March
common_rejection_risks: Failing to obtain Sending Partner nomination - only nominated applications proceed, and partner deadlines run earlier than 15 January
Choosing two programmes outside your country's eligible list, or choices irrelevant to your academic field
Scoring below 56/100 in the institutional entrance examination, which knocks you out of the final awardee list
Applying at the same study level as an existing Hungarian self-financed degree without the required recommendation and above-average credit index
Conditional awardees who never upload the missing documents by 1 August - the application is closed automatically
Applying at both degree and doctoral levels in the same round, which is not permitted
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Travel to Hungary is explicitly not covered ('the scholarship grant does not cover travel expenses'); if you rent privately the HUF 40,000/month is a contribution, not full rent, especially in Budapest; the call itself states provisions do not fully cover living costs. You also fund visa/residence-permit fees, and you need a personal reserve for the first roughly two months because administrative work delays the first instalment until around November.
document_audit: Uploads are capped at 4 MB per file - compress scans of diplomas, transcripts and certificates early
The online application form must be completed in English, with a recent photo and, for partial studies, the length in months and start date
Programme choices and their order are frozen at the deadline; only missing documents can be added later, and only with a signed declaration uploaded by 15 January promising upload by 1 August
Language certificates need an accompanying translation; previous studies fully completed in the language of the programme may be accepted in place of a certificate
A passport is not required to apply - a national ID plus declaration works - but a valid passport is essential to enter Hungary
The medical certificate must use the official template, but it is submitted in Hungary by awardees only
alerts: Compulsory two-semester Hungarian course for full-time bachelor, master and one-tier master students - fail the exam and your stipend drops to HUF 30,000 per month
Allowances are tied to physical presence: absence beyond 30 days suspends living and housing allowances, and habitual residency in Hungary is required
You cannot use other scholarships or partial studies abroad during the award; short conference stays under 30 working days are the exception
The award offer must be accepted within one week, and accepting without travelling requires withdrawal by 15 October or you are barred from the next three cycles
During term you may work at most 30 hours per week under a study residence permit, so the stipend remains the backbone of your budget
Host institution, programme and language of study can be changed only once per level, only within one year of starting, and extension semesters carry no stipend
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register in the Tempus Public Foundation system, fill the English form, upload documents, submit by 14:00 CET on 15 January, then separately satisfy your Sending Partner's national process; award offers are accepted in the system within one week and missing documents are closed out by 1 August.
